details: is a U.S. company founded and led by brothers John Aristotle Phillips and Dean Aristotle Phillips in 1983, specializing in data mining voter data for political campaigns. Obtaining and using this information helps political candidates microtarget voters.
story: Imagine a chef tasting every ingredient before it goes into the pot, deciding what belongs and what would ruin the broth. Better ingredients make a better meal, and the same is true here. Every machine is shaped by what it was shown, so someone has to choose that material with care. It is the raw material; the model is only ever as good as what it was fed. And that is Aristotle, Inc. — the unglamorous work everything else stands on.
